source.note: Kenney ambulance (FBX like car-sedan, car-van, car-delivery and the other kit cars, with Textures/colormap.png; the plan named the GLB member). Height 2.01 m puts it at the same scale as car-sedan (Kenney's 1.8 units against the sedan's 1.3 at 1.45 m), so it stands beside the van and the delivery truck: 3.63 m long and 1.67 m wide. Stylized toy proportions from Kenney (a real Japanese high-roof ambulance is about 5.6 m long and 2.5-2.8 m tall). Recoloured as a Japanese ambulance: Kenney's red lower body is white (paper, with the warm sky shade), the waistline band is the accent-red stripe, and the blue light bars are red; ink-dark windows and wheels. White with a red stripe keeps it apart from the black/white police car, the light-blue van and the white/red delivery truck (red cab, no stripe). maxColors 32 is the split where the side stripe is one clean cluster; the colour map's gradient still puts a stripe-red triangle on the roof and thin dark slivers on the rear doors. Wheels are separate nodes in the source; static, no clips.
